name: asset-class logos swap and clear to a dot
looks: Small brand and asset icons float loosely across a pale field behind a bold single word. The word hard-cuts to a second word naming a sibling asset class, with the icon field holding underneath. The icons then drift apart toward the edges and fade, leaving a single blue dot and a small data pill on screen.
build: Icon chips sit at seeded positions with a slow sine drift. The headline is one DOM block per word, hard-swapped on the beat with no crossfade. On the clearing beat each icon tweens to a far edge on power3.in, staggered 20-40ms, fading as it leaves; the last element held is a single accent dot.
sound: A soft ambient hum under the drift, a hit on the word swap, a whoosh as the icons clear.
prompt: Open on small category icons scattered and drifting behind one bold centred word, hard-cutting to a second word naming a sibling category of the same kind of thing. Let the icons drift apart to the edges and clear away, leaving one small accent dot on screen as the film's through-line mark.
